7-Zip 26.03 for macOS

This package installs a native macOS build of the official 7-Zip archiver, compiled from the unmodified 7-Zip 26.03 source release (2026-09-03) by Igor Pavlov.

Every executable is a native arm64 binary, so it runs natively on Apple Silicon. Minimum system version is macOS 11.0 (Big Sur).

This build does not run on Intel Macs. The x86_64 slice was dropped because it accounted for nearly half of the size of every executable.

The installer offers two components: the command line tools, and the 7-Zip application that provides the Finder context menu and the Quick Look archive preview. You can deselect either one on the next screen.
